story.iWant: intelligently detect common errors and perform diagnostics
story.soThat: I can provide users with accurate error information and solutions
story.tasks: Task 1: Port Occupation Detection and Resolution (AC: 1) Task 2: Permission Issue Diagnosis and Guidance (AC: 2) Task 3: Network Connectivity and Service Availability Detection (AC: 3) Task 4: Dependency Version Conflict Detection and Resolution (AC: 4) Task 5: Error Classification and Recovery Assessment System (AC: 5)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Detect port occupation issues, provide conflicting process information and resolution suggestions 2. Diagnose permission issues, provide administrator privilege application guidance 3. Detect network issues, distinguish between network failures and service unavailability 4. Identify dependency version conflicts, provide upgrade or downgrade recommendations 5. Implement error classification system, distinguish between recoverable and non-recoverable errors

doc.title: Epic Breakdown for One-Click Launch Script
doc.section: Epic 3: 错误处理与用户支持
doc.snippet: 建立完善的错误检测、诊断和恢复机制，提供智能化的用户支持。Story 3.1: 智能错误检测与诊断 - 检测端口占用问题，诊断权限问题，检测网络问题，识别依赖版本冲突，实现错误分类系统

doc.title: One-Click Launch Script Architecture
doc.snippet: psutil 7.1.3+ - 跨平台系统监控和进程管理，用途：检测端口占用、监控服务状态、获取系统信息。统一错误格式：{code, message, solution, details}。分级错误处理：WARNING(继续)、ERROR(重试)、FATAL(终止)。自动恢复机制：网络重试、端口清理、服务重启

doc.title: Product Requirements Document for One-Click Launch
doc.snippet: FR007: 脚本必须智能检测常见错误（端口占用、权限问题、网络问题），提供具体解决建议。NFR002: 错误处理 - 90%以上的常见环境问题必须能够自动检测并提供解决方案。NFR003: 用户友好性 - 所有错误信息必须用用户能理解的语言表达，避免技术术语

code.reason: 现有端口检查模块提供端口占用检测和进程识别功能，可扩展用于智能端口冲突检测
现有依赖检查模块提供版本检测和状态报告，可扩展用于依赖版本冲突检测
现有网络工具模块提供网络连接检测，可扩展用于网络问题诊断和服务可用性检查
错误处理模块基础，可扩展为智能错误检测和诊断核心
日志系统用于错误检测和诊断过程的记录
进度跟踪系统用于错误检测过程的进度管理

dependency.packages: socket, subprocess, platform, asyncio, dataclasses, enum

constraints.constraint: Use existing port_checker.py and dependency_checker.py modules as foundation for error detection
Follow unified error format {code, message, solution, details} from architecture
Integrate with existing logger.py and progress_tracker.py for consistent UX
Extend network_utils.py for comprehensive network diagnostics

tests.standards: Use pytest for unit testing, test error detection across different platforms, mock system resources for isolated testing, validate user-friendly error messages
tests.ideas: AC1: Test port occupation detection with mock processes, AC2: Test permission escalation guidance on different OS, AC3: Test network failure vs service unavailable scenarios, AC4: Test dependency version conflict detection, AC5: Test error classification accuracy
